_readme: Data for the 'Guess the angle' interactive on the home page. Every number here comes from a real completed read: `people` is how many separate customers raised that theme, `ads` is how many live competitor ads in the category lead with it, and `quotes` are verbatim from the corpus. NOTHING here is invented. If a round cannot be filled from a real report, it does not ship. The wrong answers are deliberately the themes competitors actually advertise, because that is the finding: the confident, well-funded consensus is usually the thing customers care least about. Regenerate from a real report rather than editing numbers by hand.

options.claim: It fits in your bag and goes anywhere
options.note: Real, but 14 competitor ads already lead with it. You would be the fifteenth brand saying the same sentence.

options.claim: Powerful enough to crush ice in seconds
options.note: Almost nobody raised this unprompted, yet 11 competitors advertise it. It is what brands assume buyers want.

options.claim: You can rinse it in ten seconds, not wash six parts
options.note: The loudest complaint in the category, and not one competitor ad we read answers it.

quotes.text: Cleaning the thing takes longer than making the smoothie. I stopped using mine after a month.
Six parts to wash. Six. For one drink.

options.claim: Made from responsibly sourced merino wool
options.note: The material story is what nearly every competitor runs. Buyers treat it as table stakes, not a reason.

options.claim: They last, so you buy one pair instead of five
options.note: Durability is how this audience actually argues about sustainability, and nobody is advertising it.

quotes.text: Cost per wear has changed how I shop. Rather have one piece I reach for constantly than five things that only look good for the first month.
Fabric, fit, how well it's made. I've had 50 euro sandals last 12 years and 300 euro boots fail after 2 years.

options.claim: Machine washable and ready to wear again
options.note: A feature people like once they own the shoe. It does not sell one.
